_why: ADR 0080's mutation table, re-derived under scripts/mutate.py.
NOT MY RECORD -- a concurrent agent's, and written for them rather than
asked for, per the policy set when the fifth such ADR arrived: asking
costs a line in NOT-YET-REPRODUCIBLE.txt every pass and moves nothing;
writing the set costs one additive file and closes the entry.
This one is squarely Jeske's territory. BRENDA is CC BY 4.0 and its
citation_request is an instruction -- 'cite BRENDA's current
publication' -- so a bibliography that lists every paper a value came
from while omitting the database itself omits the one citation the

mutations.description: every described source credited, contributed or not
mutations._note: The over-claiming direction. An entry for a database that supplied nothing puts a citation in someone's paper for data they did not use -- the same shape as ADR 0056's `literatureFound` column, pointed the other way.
mutations.find:
if source.citation_request
        and any(
            token in label for label in labels for token in source.tokens
        )
